CausalMix: Data Mixture as Causal Inference for Language Model Training (2026)
edges.note: Where Pearl's framework estimates the effect of a treatment on an outcome in a fixed observational setting, CausalMix makes the data mixture the treatment and the training result the outcome, conditioning on pool features so it can predict the effect of an unseen mixture on an unseen pool.

edges.target_label: CausalMix: Data Mixture as Causal Inference for Language Model Training (2026)
edges.note: DeepSeek-R1 established long chain-of-thought traces as valuable training data; CausalMix chooses the quantity of that long-CoT data in a principled way through treatment-effect estimation.

edges.target_label: HiLS-Attention: Hierarchical Sparse Attention Done Right (2026)
edges.note: Where the Transformer read every token pair at quadratic cost, HiLS keeps content-based addressing but only over chunks it learns to retrieve under the language-modeling loss, so the retrieval scores enter the attention computation directly and selection is differentiable.

edges.target_label: HiLS-Attention: Hierarchical Sparse Attention Done Right (2026)
edges.note: Where Mamba compressed history into a fixed recurrent state and lost content-based random access, HiLS keeps attention's content addressing over selected chunks while still cutting cost below quadratic.

Where DeepSeek-V3's multi-token prediction drafts several tokens in parallel but loses acceptance on later ones, DSpark restores within-block dependency with a small sequential head and schedules verification by load.
DeepSeek-V2 is the upstream architecture whose high-concurrency serving stack DSpark accelerates.
The autoregressive Transformer is the backbone DSpark speeds up at the serving-systems layer rather than the model-quality layer.
The autoregressive Transformer supplies left-to-right language priors and verification in the joint objective.
Where DeepSeek-V3 decodes with multi-token prediction, Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion displaces it with diffusion drafting plus autoregressive verification in self-speculation mode.

edges.target_label: Extending LLM Context via Associative Recurrent Memory (2026)
edges.note: Where the Transformer keeps information inside a fixed-length attention window, this work adds a recurrent associative memory that carries a compressed state across segments, so effective context grows without full quadratic attention over everything.

edges.target_label: Extending LLM Context via Associative Recurrent Memory (2026)
edges.note: Where the memory survey catalogued mechanisms, this work commits to one and supplies the training curriculum and selective-layer placement that make it hold past the original context limit.

Where DeepSeek-R1 trains reasoning from verifiable outcome rewards, this paper studies the dense token-level signal of on-policy distillation and shows it acts as an exploration catalyst rather than a higher capability ceiling, then adds two regularizers to keep the signal faithful.

Where Chain-of-Thought elicits reasoning paths by prompting, this paper treats those paths as the behavior on-policy distillation transfers and names two failure modes, student-teacher mismatch and length exploitation, that break the transfer.

Where DeepSeek-R1 produced reasoning through RL and left an expensive teacher, OPD^2 does cheap transfer of exactly that ability by distilling the teacher-minus-base delta rather than copying the whole teacher distribution.

Where Chain-of-Thought established the reasoning-trace target that distillation transfers, OPD^2 isolates that added reasoning behavior as the delta between the tuned teacher and its base model and distills only that.

edges.target_label: Predictive Divergence Masks for LLM RL (2026)
edges.note: Where PPO clips updates on a single-sample importance ratio, this paper replaces the direction test with a predicted change in the trust-region divergence itself, because the ratio is a noisy proxy that can point the wrong way.

edges.target_label: Predictive Divergence Masks for LLM RL (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 made RL from verifiable rewards the standard recipe for reasoning models, this paper sharpens the trust-region machinery underneath rather than changing the reward or the task.

edges.target_label: Predictive Divergence Masks for LLM RL (2026)
edges.note: Where Latent-GRPO is a group-relative policy-optimization variant relying on the ratio-based mask, this paper supplies a consistent direction test that predicts the change in the same divergence the proximity test measures.

Where PonderLM spends extra forward passes within one token step and feeds back a distribution-weighted mixture of token embeddings, this paper feeds the top-layer hidden state back across token steps, so the target is a persistent latent channel rather than more thinking time at one position.

Where the Latent Reasoning Survey argued that latent computation should replace the verbalized chain, this paper keeps the verbal chain and adds latent state alongside it, which is why the language-modeling objective and standard decoding survive unchanged.
The only structural edit to the base architecture is on the input side, which is what keeps per-token decoding overhead negligible and the KV cache intact.

Rabinowitz learned a predictor of another agent's behaviour and stopped at prediction; StudentSim requires the learned model to also move correctly when the observed agent is instructed, and scores that as a second property.

edges.source_label: CounselBench: LLM Benchmarking in Mental Health (Li 2025)
edges.note: CounselBench evaluates a model against per-person records as a benchmark endpoint; StudentSim closes the loop and spends the fitted per-person model as a reward signal for training a tutor.
Durante frames simulated agents as environments for training other agents; StudentSim supplies a fitted per-individual environment and measures both how well it imitates and how well it responds.

edges.target_label: Declarative Attention: Language Models Can Control Their Own Attention (2026)
edges.note: Vaswani fixed the attention span as a property of the architecture; Declarative Attention makes the span a decision the model takes at run time, because a fixed span is no longer affordable at million-token context.

edges.target_label: Declarative Attention: Language Models Can Control Their Own Attention (2026)
edges.note: Wei used the reasoning trace to hold intermediate answers; here the trace holds control instructions the serving engine executes, which turns it from an output artifact into a compute-scheduling signal.

edges.target_label: Declarative Attention: Language Models Can Control Their Own Attention (2026)
edges.note: DeepSeek-V3 cut KV cache cost by compressing each key and value entry; this paper leaves the entry alone and declines to read most of them, so the two reductions compose.
